summary: iQIYI, Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release of its unaudited second-quarter 2026 financial results. The filing reports total revenues of RMB6.29 billion (down 5% year over year) and a net loss attributable to iQIYI of RMB287.5 million (US$42.4 million). Management comments highlight strategic progress in AI and content leadership, and mention implementation of a share repurchase program. The filing is an ordinary periodic earnings report with no special-situation transaction, such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. No deal terms or extraordinary corporate actions are disclosed; the share repurchase mention is generic and not an event-level announcement.
